cohort: The study included 47,697 women who were beneficiaries of a South African medical insurance scheme and delivered a child between 2011 and 2020.
finding: PPD risk was significantly higher in individuals with a history of depression, preterm delivery, PCOS, hyperemesis gravidarum, gestational hypertension, and postpartum haemorrhage.
mod_finding: Elective or emergency C-section and perineal laceration were not associated with a higher risk of PPD.
